title: Packing Services in Burbank | SOS Moving
metaDescription: Packing services in Burbank, CA for older houses and new condos: room-by-room packing, boxes billed only when used, free tape and stretch wrap, and unpacking.
heroSubtitle: Room-by-room packing for Burbank’s older houses and newer condos, with tape and stretch wrap never added to the bill

faq.question: Can a crew start packing my Burbank home the same day I call?
faq.answer: Often, yes: if one of our crews has an open slot, it can come out the same day. Call early; our hours are 8AM to 6PM on all seven days. A same-day job starts with the rooms you need emptied first, and the crew brings the boxes.

faq.question: How do I know how many boxes a Burbank house will need?
faq.answer: You do not have to guess. The crew brings a mix of small, medium and large boxes, from $4 each, and you pay only for the ones that get filled. No tape or stretch wrap charges appear on the bill, whatever the job uses.

faq.question: My Burbank condo association wants proof of insurance before packers come in. What do you need from me?
faq.answer: Pass us the names and address your association wants printed on it; the certificate costs $50. Ask management at the same time whether packing day needs its own booking, since rules differ from building to building.

faq.question: Will you pack a detached garage at the back of the lot?
faq.answer: Yes. We treat it as a separate room with its own labels and pack it early, so its cartons are sealed before loading starts. Please set aside anything hazardous, such as paint thinner or propane, because it cannot go on the truck.

faq.question: Can you unpack at the new place if I am moving within Burbank?
faq.answer: Yes. Unpacking is part of what we offer, and you can ask for all of it or only the kitchen and bedrooms. The crew opens the cartons in the rooms written on them, so the kitchen can be working the same evening.
